rationale: The general table lists direct 10.0-to-10.6; the KV-specific guide requires 10.2 or higher first. Cohosted migration requires KV 7.0+, disk, health and parallel backup, impairs writes and can be postponed. Current procedure names ITSI 5.0.x and lower; the ES matrix boundary is independently scoped. No UF inheritance.

deployments: Customer-managed Enterprise package with KV Store
audiences: Customers and documentation readers evaluating the stated decision
exclusions: KV-specific prerequisite; not applied to Universal Forwarders or Cloud-managed upgrade routes.
